title: A migrated project is not told to declare Chough's merge lines and drivers, so doctor reports merge_drivers after every migration
symptom: After chough migrate --apply, doctor reports merge_drivers for the three .gitattributes lines and both drivers, while the plan's and receipt's follow-ups name only the verification exclusions
trigger: Migrate any 0.5.x project, then chough doctor
expected: The migration's follow-ups say how to declare the merge lines and set the drivers (REQ-cli-047), as they already do for the verification exclusions
environment: local-macos-arm64, tester build at 596ced67, debug, SpecSync 6.3.0
impact: A migrated project merges its generated files with Git's text merge until someone runs doctor

notes.text: status: open -> investigating. Red at f59f10fe (before its fix, SpecSync 6.3.0 on PATH): the plan's follow-ups named no merge line; fix in a2591337.
status: investigating -> verified. Green at a2591337: TC-records-the-migration-names-the-merge-setup passed; migrate, migrate_knowledge, migrate_bugs, migrate_evidence and docs tests pass.
